remaining: Full preceding-survey history, with its own instrument and methodological review.
Additional chapter state statements, beyond the appendix measures and RSE tables.
methodology: Original report workbook cells; observed cuts only, no fabricated cross-tabs. Separate participation, per-participant time and per-person time. All-activities time equally allocates each recorded slot. No causal effects or unmatched-household sharing claims.
